user_query: I want to create a sports website that covers transfer news, latest transfers, and player market value.

TaskList.description: Access the transfer records API to retrieve information about players, transfers, and their trade values.
Process the data obtained from the transfer records API to extract relevant details for the website.
Access the game plans API to retrieve short information about upcoming competitions.
Combine the information from transfers and game plans to create content for the website.
Develop the front end of the website to display the transfer news, player market value, and game plans.
